steps.name: Pull the dark tabby stripes
steps.part: The cat's stripes and pink ears

lines.text: Let the cat's shape and the blanket dry to the touch first. A hair dryer on low speeds it up.
Rinse the brush well first. Dirty water tints every color with the last one.
Inside the outlined area. Its top is about 1 1/2 in from the top edge, and its right side is about 1 in from the right edge; it's about 13 1/2 in wide and 6 1/2 in tall.
The outline also runs under where the cat's sleeping face and the cat's fur will go: paint straight through there.
The outline also reaches onto the sleeping tabby cat and the blue wall, painted already: there, only soften this paint into their edge and leave them showing.
Paint: Charcoal.
Mix enough Charcoal for this step and step 20; cover it between them.
Brush: 1/4 inch angle.
Press the full width of the brush for the thick part, then turn onto its edge or tip and lighten the pressure. With an angle brush, the lighter you press, the thinner the line.
It should leave a line that starts wide and tapers to a point.

steps.meant: The cat has curving charcoal tabby stripes over its gray body, tail and head. The ears are gray inside; no fur flicks or face yet.

steps.name: Paint the pink inside the ears
steps.part: The cat's stripes and pink ears

lines.text: Let the cat's shape and the blanket dry to the touch first. A hair dryer on low speeds it up.
Inside the outlined area. Its top is about 1 1/2 in from the top edge, and its left side is about 1 1/4 in from the left edge; it's about 5 1/2 in wide and 4 in tall.
The outline also runs under where the cat's sleeping face and the cat's fur will go: paint straight through there.
The outline also reaches onto the cat's shading and white patches, and the yellow knit blanket, painted already: there, only soften this paint into their edge and leave them showing.
Paint: Soft pink.
Mix enough Soft pink for this step and step 19; cover it between them.
Brush: #4 round. Load: Creamy paint, a full load.
Touch down with the tip, press so the belly spreads, then pull and lift so the stroke ends on the tip.
It should leave a teardrop or comma shape, wide where you pressed and pointed where you lifted.
Leave what step 16 painted showing around these marks, as in the Result picture.
Watch out: A blob instead of a teardrop. Too much paint, or too slow a lift. Fix: use less paint and lift faster.
Step back, squint, or take a photo to see it whole, and compare the big shapes with the picture.

steps.meant: Both ears are pink inside with a gray rim. The fur is still smooth and there is no face yet.
